chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from Al-Husayn ibn Khalid, from Al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) used to say: 'Wear rings with rubies, for they remove poverty.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of wearing ruby rings according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) narrates that Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) advised wearing rings set with rubies (yawāqīt) as a means to alleviate or remove poverty. This hadith links specific gemstones to spiritual and material benefits within Shia tradition, reflecting the broader Shi'i emphasis on the symbolic and metaphysical properties of creation as signs of divine grace.
